why: The running copy must hear a second copy of itself (another bundle path with the same bundle id) while it is in the background, which is when a second copy is opened (Leo 2026-11-08, Mac setup: an older NIGHTLY kept running and a newer download silently handed off to it). The only cross-process channel that reaches a backgrounded app with no new permission is one distributed-notification registration with deliverImmediately, filtered by the bundle id, owned by AppCopyGuide (constructed once in AppDelegate) and removed in its deinit. No existing adapter observes the distributed center for app-defined names.
